title: An edited value and a stored record: locating the boundary
goal: Distinguish manager lookup, editable object and selection cursor while testing the moment a name is saved.

prerequisites.text: Complete P1–P3. Distinguish a common-module function from its application caller; preserve your source and run a separate training infobase.

sections.title: The question we are checking
paragraphs: You changed a name in an object. Will a fresh database read see it? Check when the edit becomes persistent and distinguish manager, reference, editable object, and selection.
Use a new training copy and invented records only. Predict first, then compare the observation; preserve existing functions, files, and records.

sections.title: Managers operate on a type
paragraphs: Catalogs.Customers provides type-wide creation and lookup operations.GetObject belongs to a particular reference; a selection traverses items. A manager is not an already-loaded array of objects: traversal and reads follow the API’s rules.

Справочники.Клиенты manages this object kind: it creates items and finds references by code within the catalog. ПолучитьОбъект gives an editable state of one record. After changing its name but before Записать, a fresh read should still see the stored name. After writing, lookup by the same code returns the new name.

sections.title: The application call and its observation
paragraphs: The worked example saves an initial name, obtains an editable object, and changes it in memory. A separate read sees the old name before saving and the new one afterward. The selection finds the needed reference by comparison rather than assuming a list position.
Each message is labelled: identical Да values concern different assertions. Find the expression behind each line and distinguish its truth from the fact that the program ran.

sections.title: A cursor needs advancing
paragraphs: AfterSelect, advance withNext in a loop. Read fields from the current position, not before the first advance. Test an empty selection separately: zero iterations should produce the agreed empty result. Traversed count alone does not prove there were no hidden conditions.

A selection starts before its first row. Пока Выборка.Следующий() advances the cursor and reports whether another row exists. The example compares references instead of relying on a fixed position. Additional customers need not be deleted to match an illustration.

sections.title: Your prediction first
paragraphs: The in-memory edit exists, but Записать is omitted. Which name should a fresh read return?
Identify the changed action and what should remain unchanged. Reveal the explanation after making your own prediction.

reveal.title: Check the reasoning
paragraphs: The old name. Obtaining and editing an object does not replace saving it. A fresh read distinguishes a stored result from a value in an open draft.

sections.title: Modification needs an object
paragraphs: For one card, obtain the object, validate current data andWrite. Bulk edits during traversal need care: changing selection conditions may affect later membership. In the starter exercise, collect references first and modify them in a separate controlled pass.

Separate object, reference and selection row. Persistence occurs explicitly through Черновик.Записать(). An in-memory presentation change is not a durable result. Bulk processing needs separate filter, transaction, permission and performance rules; one teaching loop does not establish them.

sections.title: Trace preservation step by step
paragraphs: The diagram transfers that order to the independent rate task. An in-memory 800 coexists with saved 600. Only after saving does a fresh read return 800; this is a distinct observable step.
Read each arrow: what value or relation exists now, and which action changes it? The diagram explains the selected property rather than replacing the source.

sections.title: An error that can look successful
paragraphs: Suppose saving is omitted but the edited object’s own name is printed: the line looks correct. Reread through the preserved reference or manager and compare that value instead. Then restore saving in your own copy.
Keep the faulty copy separate. To establish a fix, compare the relevant observation with your prior expectation; do not change an expectation merely to obtain a match.

sections.title: Operations need an observable trace
paragraphs: For reporting reads, compare identities and call counts with no writes. For one-card editing, compare only expected fields. Include empty sets and repeated execution. This shows the API choice follows the task rather than an accidental chain of unnecessary object accesses.

The original returns three true claims: unchanged storage before write, changed storage afterward and the desired reference found in selection. The incorrect variant omits writing: syntax remains valid and the item is found, but its new name is not stored. Each execution creates one test item; remove its startup call and record its code afterward.

sections.title: Now a new independent task
paragraphs: Create a new training service with saved rate 600. Obtain its editable object and set 800, but first reread the stored rate. Then save and reread by code. Display the draft rate, the stored value before saving, the value afterward, and reference preservation.
The worked example addresses another question. Begin with this task’s starter and reveal the reference after your attempt. Viewing an example or reference does not replace your code.

sections.title: Where to run it and what to observe in 1C
paragraphs: УчебныеДанные common module: Server and Server call enabled; Client, Global, and Privileged disabled. Functions are outside procedures. The application module has one handler that calls the function and displays labelled result fields.

Preserve the previous handler separately. Run the experiment once in your copy, compare labelled messages and specific new records, then remove only the added startup call. Do not delete records to match a screenshot.

sections.title: Limits of the observation and your explanation
paragraphs: The chosen training path is checked in a file infobase. This does not establish all permissions, bulk changes, network-server behaviour, or learner understanding. A run, a saved completion mark, and an explanation are separate facts.
Explain manager, object, and selection roles; one experiment does not validate bulk transactions.
